import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy import sparse as sp

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Load sample submission to verify expected column names
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")

# Preprocess text: remove surrounding quotes and normalize whitespace for feature extraction
train_df["Comment_processed"] = (
    train_df["Comment"]
    .str.strip('"')
    .str.replace(r"\n", " ", regex=True)
    .str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
)
test_df["Comment_processed"] = (
    test_df["Comment"]
    .str.strip('"')
    .str.replace(r"\n", " ", regex=True)
    .str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
)

# Extract features preserving original order
X_text = train_df["Comment_processed"].tolist()
X_test_text = test_df["Comment_processed"].tolist()

# 1. Word-level TF-IDF (1-2 grams)
vectorizer_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2), sublinear_tf=True, min_df=2
)
X_train_word = vectorizer_word.fit_transform(X_text)
X_test_word = vectorizer_word.transform(X_test_text)

# 2. Character-level TF-IDF (3-4 grams) for substrings
vectorizer_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(3, 4), analyzer="char", sublinear_tf=True, min_df=1
)
X_train_char = vectorizer_char.fit_transform(X_text)
X_test_char = vectorizer_char.transform(X_test_text)

# Stack features horizontally
X_train = sp.hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char], format="csr")
X_test = sp.hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char], format="csr")

# Split training data into train and validation (80/20)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train,
    train_df["Insult"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["Insult"],
)

# Calculate class balance weight for XGBoost
n_neg = (y_tr == 0).sum()
n_pos = (y_tr == 1).sum()
scale_pos_weight = n_neg / n_pos

# Train Base Models (removed incorrect set_params call)
model_xgb = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    objective="binary:logistic",
    random_state=42,
    eval_metric="auc",
    scale_pos_weight=scale_pos_weight,
)
model_xgb.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

model_lr = LogisticRegression(
    solver="lbfgs",
    max_iter=1000,
    class_weight="balanced",
    random_state=42,
)
model_lr.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Get Base Model Validation Predictions
y_pred_xgb_val = model_xgb.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
y_pred_lr_val = model_lr.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
X_meta_val = np.column_stack([y_pred_xgb_val, y_pred_lr_val])

# Train Meta-Learner (Stacking)
meta_model = LogisticRegression(
    solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1
)
meta_model.fit(X_meta_val, y_val)

# Evaluate AUC-ROC on validation set using meta-learner prediction
y_pred_val = meta_model.predict_proba(X_meta_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_pred_val)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.5f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
y_pred_xgb_test = model_xgb.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
y_pred_lr_test = model_lr.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
X_meta_test = np.column_stack([y_pred_xgb_test, y_pred_lr_test])
y_pred_test = meta_model.predict_proba(X_meta_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission file matching sample submission format
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Comment": test_df["Comment"].astype(str),
        "Date": test_df["Date"].astype(str),
        "Insult": y_pred_test.astype(float),
    }
)

print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Test set shape: {test_df.shape}")

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
